The '''Mk IV Flat-Twin Turbojet''', also spelled '''Mark IV Flat-Twin Turbojet''', was a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] engine model produced by [[Manta RamAir/Legends|Manta RamAir]] prior to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]] had piloted this model of podracer. It had poor acceleration and turning, but did have an excellent speed boost system to make up for it.
